title: T1584.008 — Compromise Infrastructure - Network Devices
subtitle: Watch an attacker find an exposed router, take it over, turn it into a proxy and sniffer, and pivot into the network behind it - while the SOC closes in.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker compromises an internet-facing network device, uses it as a proxy and sniffer, pivots into the victim network, and a SOC detects, isolates, and rebuilds the device. A written step-by-step version follows below.
